upload_rule: The user chooses one catalog ID and uploads one image. The verifier must inspect that image against the selected ID.

statuses.VALID_MATCH: The selected model is supported and a linked model identifier or trusted model-specific evidence matches it. Continue claim checks.
statuses.DEVICE_MISMATCH: The image identifies a different supported catalog model.
statuses.INVALID_DEVICE: The clear subject is outside the six-product catalog or is unrelated to the selected category.
statuses.UNCLEAR_IMAGE: Image quality or missing linked evidence prevents a reliable identity decision. Request a new photo.
statuses.HUMAN_REVIEW: Authenticity, duplicate, edit, replay, registry, or other fraud signal needs review.

response_shape.status: one of the five status keys
response_shape.authenticity: REAL_UNVERIFIED | SYNTHETIC_SIGNAL | EDIT_SIGNAL | REPLAY_SIGNAL | DUPLICATE_SIGNAL | UNKNOWN

identity_limit: A visual-only photo can suggest category or model family. It must not claim exact model identity or real-world authenticity without linked, readable evidence or a human review path.
